name: movstd
expr: y_def = movstd(A, 3); y_omit = movstd(A, 3, 'omitnan'); y_norm = movstd(A2, 3, 1); y_disc = movstd(A2, 3, 'Endpoints', 'discard'); y_k2 = movstd(A2, 2); y_z = movstd(A2, [0 0]); y_o2 = movstd(A, 2, 'omitnan');
comment: Sig: movstd(A, k[, normFlag] [, dim] [, nanflag] [, Name, Value]). normFlag in {0 (default, N-1), 1 (N)}. Same nanflag/Endpoints surface as movmean. 2026-05-30: single-element-window std is 0, not NaN (MATLAB parity) — y_k2(1)=0 (edge of a length-2 window), y_z(5)=0 (length-1 window everywhere via [0 0]), y_o2(7)=y_o2(8)=0 (omitnan reduces those windows to one valid element).
